tail:
Batch 10 (DT-18, The Hopf Degree Theorem) is fully scaffolded. Summary of the work and its evidence:

## Deliverables (all under `research/`)
- **`frontier-41-ha-dt-29-batch-10.pages.json`** — A page (order 551) with **20 items** and B page (552) with **5 items**; every item has explicit `deps`, a full statement, proof strategy, provenance, per-item sources and a tool-computed `dependency_level` (0–9, distribution 0:2, 1:2, 2:4, 3:2, 4:2, 5:3, 6:2, 7:4, 8:3, 9:1).
- **`…-batch-10.coverage.json`** — 3 full-text treatments (Freed Lecture 2 pp. 20–24; Milnor Chs. 7–8 pp. 42–51; Guillemin–Pollack Ch. 3 §6 pp. 141–147 + Ch. 2 §4 pp. 82–84), 43 harvested rows with dispositions, all 6 source entries fetch-stamped.
- **`…-batch-10.cross-batch-dependencies.json`** — 25 reviewed consumer rows (24 item edges + the page edge to DT-17).
- **`…-batch-10.notes.md`** — decisions, conflicts, dependency audit, choice bookkeeping, source evidence, checks, outstanding findings.
- **25 `…-step1-<id>.json`** readiness records (`ready`, current hashes).
- `…-batch-10-url-liveness.json` (3/3 live).

## Mathematical content
All 14 designed A items and 5 B items are preserved. **6 local prerequisites** were added for closure: the frame bundle of a manifold, its component structure (Freed 2.44), the path-of-framings cobordism lemma (2.45), disjoint-union additivity, and a mod-two degree definition + well-definedness/homotopy-invariance lemma (no mod-two degree existed on disk). The route keeps the design's hard-proof closure exactly: framed-cobordism classification of framed points (signed count ↔ ℤ, parity ↔ ℤ/2), the de Rham comparison, realization of every degree, inverse PT, then the two Hopf theorems.

## Conflicts / findings recorded (not silently resolved)
- Design order 7–8 before 9–10 corrected to prerequisite order (ids unchanged).
- Plan §8's GP register row omits Ch. 3 §6, the very section DT-18 cites; §6 read in full and harvested.
- Design item 11 and B items 1–2 overlap published content (based sphere classification; circle-power and reflection examples) — kept at designed strength and flagged for owner reconciliation.
- Design item 5 sharpened to the framed ambient statement needed by the PT route (published DT-15 proposition gives the abstract case).
- Design item 2 tightened to a closed ambient with support in a chart ball so it instantiates DT-17's framed-cobordism definition.

## Checks (final snapshot; other batches still landing)
`item-dependency-levels` — only other batches' empty inventories; **no batch-10 error**. `manifest-deps` 25/25 and whole-run 329 items 0 errors; `content-policy --manifest-only` (batch 10 + its in-run supplier batch 9) 50 items 0/0, whole-run 329 items 0/0; `coverage-checklist --require-destination` 0 errors/0 warnings; `source-fetch-check` 6/6 verified; `url-sweep` 3/3 live; `validate-plan` and `extcheck` exit 0; `manifest-integrity` no scope drift; `step1-decisions` — all 25 batch-10 items current, none among the unresolved work; frontier dependency ledger refreshed with all 25 edges reviewed.

No item was escalated; no published defect blocks this pair. One reconciliation note is recorded: DT-17 is still in flight, so any later change to a batch-9 supplier statement will invalidate the affected readiness records and trigger the ordinary Step-1 recompute.
